tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: THE brand colour, Night Signal's one accent: a lit screen on a dark road. Main button, live state, the one key number, the logo symbol. Text on it is always `midnight` (15.3:1), never white. Never volt text on light grounds (1.15:1 on `paper`); use `brand-ink`. One volt thing per view.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Brand dark. Dark grounds, every on-bike screen ground, app bars, the wordmark on `paper` and on `volt`. `paper` text on it 17.6:1, `volt` 15.3:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand light. Light grounds, print, the wordmark on `midnight`. `ink` text on it 17.1:1.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised dark surface on `midnight`: cards on dark, the screen frame, the rider app's tiles. Text `paper` (15.7:1) or dark `ink-muted` (7.4:1); `volt` 13.6:1.

tokens.name: ion
tokens.usage: Data and maps on dark: second chart series, map routes, heat-map lows. 5.5:1 on `midnight`, 4.9:1 on `graphite`. Not for text on light grounds; use `data` there.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. `ink` on it 17.1:1 light, 17.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tiles, tables: chalk white on paper, graphite on midnight. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `ink-subtle` all pass on it (subtle 6.3:1 light, 5.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells, table bands, input wells. `ink` 15.3:1 / 15.7:1, `ink-muted` 8.1:1 / 7.4:1, `ink-subtle` 5.0:1 / 5.4:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders, 1px. Decorative separation only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes (light 3.7 / 4.1 / 3.3:1, dark 3.6 / 3.3 / 3.2:1 on `surface-0` / `-1` / `-2`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and headings on every surface (17:1 on `surface-0` in both themes; 15:1+ on `surface-2`).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, table body on all surfaces (9.7:1 light, 10.2:1 dark on `surface-0`; 8.6:1+ everywhere). A warm grey with a hint of the paper green, never a cold blue-grey.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, footnotes, timestamps on `surface-0` and `surface-1` (5.8:1+ light, 5.7:1+ dark). 5.2:1 / 5.5:1 on `surface-2`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand fills in UI: the main button, live state, the one highlighted number tile. Text on it is `on-brand`. One per view.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` (15.3:1). Never white on volt.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as TEXT: eyebrows, links, the hero number on light grounds (5.6:1 on `surface-0` light, 5.0:1 on `surface-2`; 15.3:1 dark). Plain `volt` text on `paper` fails at 1.15:1; use this.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet accent wash: selected chip, highlighted table row, callout ground. Text `ink` (17.2:1 light, 12.6:1 dark) or `brand-ink` (5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: data
tokens.usage: Second data series, links, map routes; as text 6.2:1 light, 5.5:1 dark on `surface-0`.

tokens.name: data-soft
tokens.usage: Data wash: map areas, selected series band. Text `ink` (15.5:1 / 13.9:1); `data` text on it 5.6:1 light but only 4.3:1 dark, so use `ink` on it in dark.

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Status: done, paid, delivered, moving. Always with a word or icon. As text 4.9:1 on `surface-0` light (use on `surface-0`/`surface-1`, not `surface-2` at 4.4:1); 10.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: go-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a `go` chip or row. `go` text on it 4.7:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Status: errors, shortfalls, failed checks. Always with a word or icon. As text 5.0:1 light, 6.9:1 dark on `surface-0`. UI only: never on on-bike screens (red reads as a brake light).

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a `stop` chip or error row. `stop` text on it 4.6:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Ink on light, volt on dark (13:1+ on every surface).

families.body: "Instrument Sans", "Anek Telugu", "Anek Devanagari", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: The city at night, on screen.
styles.usage: Brand moments only: sign-in pages, report covers, the website, slides. Instrument Serif 400; the key words may be italic in `brand-ink` or `volt` on dark.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Book a street like you book a stay.
styles.usage: Section openers and empty-state headlines. Instrument Serif 400. Never inside tables or forms.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page headlines in the apps. Instrument Sans 600, tight tracking.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen: earnings, a total. Instrument Sans 600, tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, table titles. Instrument Sans 600.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Brands buy bike-hours. Riders are paid for moving hours.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and marketing pages. Instrument Sans 400; `ink-muted` for secondary leads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The clock pauses after 10 minutes standing still.
styles.usage: Default UI and document text. Instrument Sans 400/500 (430 on dark grounds, where thin strokes fade). Measure 60–72 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, menu group names, uppercase column labels. Instrument Sans 600, lightly tracked.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Before GST. People counts are approximate.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, GST numbers, codes and logs: IBM Plex Mono 500. Money and counts stay in Instrument Sans with tabular figures, so they read as words. Indian digit grouping.

styles.name: telugu-headline
styles.usage: Telugu headlines in the rider app and local-brand creatives. Anek Telugu 600. Needs the extra line height for vowel signs.

styles.name: telugu-body
styles.usage: Telugu body copy in the rider app and posters. Anek Telugu 400.

spacing.note: 8-point grid with a 4px half step. Layouts use 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label over value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap; button horizontal padding; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding; poster margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding, slide margins (scaled).

radius.note: Design 2.0 corners: 10px on controls, 16px on cards, 24px on sheets and hero panels, pills for chips.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, small inputs, keyboard keys, the geofenced field highlight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, menu items, selectable table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, tiles, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, hero panels, screen frames, photo cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, filter chips, toggles and the brand search bar.

shadow.note: Layered depth: rest for cards, hover for what the pointer is on, lift for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and secondary buttons at rest: just enough to lift chalk off paper.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: A card or photo the pointer is over, a booking card that follows the page.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: menus, popovers, the search box (Ctrl K), side panels, toasts.

motion.note: Quick to answer, slow to settle. Nothing moves when the viewer asks for reduced motion.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: A button or tile pressing in (scale 0.97).

tokens.name: duration-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and fade changes.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Pages cross-fading, panels sliding, tabs moving.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Numbers rolling, bars growing, lists arriving one by one.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things changing in place: loops, shimmer.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Sheets, switches and toasts: a small, gentle overshoot.
